description.value: DunnEnzies Pizza Co. is the original flagship downtown Kelowna location of a popular local pizza chain, situated in the heart of the city on Ellis Street. The restaurant is known for its creatively named Italian-American inspired pizzas and a lively atmosphere anchored by regular live music, comedy nights, and occasional drag and theatre events. Dine-in and takeout options make it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists exploring downtown Kelowna.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: lockers (secure) at 63m; lockers (secure) at 64m; lockers (secure) at 66m; lockers (secure) at 67m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the downtown Kelowna location at 1559 Ellis St with phone (250) 763-2420, and explicitly states 'DINE IN. TAKE OUT. DELIVERY.' OSM tags corroborate address and delivery. The menu pages show numerous items marked (V) for vegetarian. No website evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities.
